page.layout: One column of running text; a marginal note in the right margin beside "Redgerum dicere". Running head at top, page number at top right. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: cešores sibi dešignare: hos‽ cognoscendi ju‐dicandi‽; potestatem habuisse de negotiis & querelis omnibus omnium hospitum ac pere‐grinorum Dammonami venientium, sine contradictione: similiter de contractibus quibusvis coram ipsis judicibus initis, de promissionibus itidem apud eos factis, decisâ æstimationis parte quartâ; prætereâ de dam‐nis pecudum vi Dammonensi a Dammonensi illatis: at de membrorum mutilatione & de vulneribus judicium eorum non fuisse, nisi facinus patratum esset ipsis præsentibus, aut incendii tempore: Et tamen in eo quoq; casu Consulis, id est, judicis superioris, quem Redgerum dicere mos est,Redger. multam ex lege fuisse, non secus ac si ipse judicasset: eosdem judices illos ter quotannis judicia exercuisse per dies quinos: ter item pondera & mensuras examinasse; panis quoq; venalis, cerevi‐siæ, vini, viarum, puteorum, & similium rationem & curam habuisse, (quod ædili‐um annonæ præfectorum solet munus esse:) litem introductam ad horum tribu‐nal, si lis hujusce tribunalis esset, non licuisse litigantibus, judicibus his despectis, alio traducere: si quis contra fecisset, seu actor

page.notes: Cesores (first word of the page) is the least certain reading: the printed form could be read differently and is marked [?] in the text. Run-over hyphens are kept as printed. The marginal note "Redger." is set in the right margin. Long s is transcribed as s throughout.
